evidence_units.claim: The active provider/model resolves validated compaction settings, and the same resolved object is consumed by manual, threshold, overflow, and post-run paths.
evidence_units.oracle: Exact override/fallback/invalid-value assertions and model-switch/entry-point characterization tests.

evidence_units.claim: Next-turn preparation is evaluated only when the loop continues toward a real assistant request; terminating tool results do not trigger compaction.
evidence_units.oracle: Continuation tests observe compaction before provider; terminating-tool test observes no compaction event or compaction entry.

evidence_units.claim: When trailing tool results exceed the retained budget, compaction falls back to the latest valid cut point instead of losing the current tool-call boundary.
evidence_units.oracle: Regression test asserts exact first-kept index/id, split-turn index, summarized history, and retained turn prefix.

evidence_units.claim: Context-visible custom entries contribute to budget accounting and can change the selected cut point.
evidence_units.oracle: The custom-message budget test asserts different cut points for tiny versus fitting budgets.

evidence_units.claim: Aider derives a bounded chat-history budget from model input capability and passes an explicit caller-selected value into ChatSummary.
evidence_units.oracle: ChatSummary is initialized with an explicit max_tokens value; Model stores max_chat_history_tokens derived from max_input_tokens.

evidence_units.claim: Aider selects older messages that fit the summarizer input budget, summarizes that prefix, retains the recent tail, and recursively rechecks the combined result.
evidence_units.oracle: test_too_big checks the gate, test_tokenize checks measured inputs, and test_summarize checks the result is smaller than the original.

evidence_units.claim: Summarizer failure does not silently discard the original history: Aider keeps it and warns; the multi-model summarizer can also try the next configured model.
evidence_units.oracle: test_fallback_to_second_model asserts both attempts and the second summary; the exact coder-switch warning path is implementation-evidenced but lacks a dedicated checked-in test.

case_actions.semantic_goal: Resolve model-specific compaction policy with explicit precedence and safe integer validation.
Use the active model's resolved policy at every compaction entry point.
Run pressure preparation at the next real assistant/provider request boundary and skip terminal turns.
Choose the latest safe cut point before an oversized trailing tool result.
Include every context-visible session entry in budget and cut-point accounting.
Derive a bounded summarizer/history budget from model input capability and an explicit caller override.
Select a maximal older prefix that fits, retain a recent tail, and recheck the combined result.
Keep original history and warn when a summarization path fails.

case_workflows.goal: Keep active-model compaction policy effective at the actual next-request boundary while preserving a valid session boundary under oversized input.
guards: If the tool result terminates the turn, do not prepare a next request.
If trailing results exceed keepRecentTokens, choose the latest valid boundary rather than dropping the current tool-call turn.

case_workflows.goal: Fit historical context into a summarizer budget while avoiding destructive loss when summarization fails.
guards: Only summarize when the measured history exceeds the configured limit.
If summarization raises the handled failure, keep the original messages and emit a visible warning.

atomic_candidates.problem_mechanism: A runtime can resolve a compaction policy once and then apply stale or wrong settings after model selection changes.
atomic_candidates.operator: Resolve ordinary settings and exact provider/model overrides with validation, then pass one resolved policy through every compaction entry point.
postconditions: The active model selects the intended policy.
Manual, automatic, overflow, and switched-model paths agree.

atomic_candidates.problem_mechanism: Preparing compaction after a terminating tool result performs work for a request that will never be sent, while preparing too late lets the next request start under pressure.
atomic_candidates.operator: Place the pressure check in the continuation path immediately before a real next assistant/provider request and skip terminal outcomes.
postconditions: Compaction precedes the next provider request when required.

atomic_candidates.problem_mechanism: A trailing tool result can exceed the retained budget before a normal cut point is found.
atomic_candidates.operator: When pressure is reached, choose the nearest valid cut point at/after the pressure index, otherwise fall back to the latest valid cut point before the oversized tail.
postconditions: The current tool-call/result relationship remains representable.
Older history is compactable without discarding the active turn prefix.

atomic_candidates.problem_mechanism: Budget measurement can omit custom/session entries that are visible to the provider.
atomic_candidates.operator: Use one context-visible projection for both token accounting and cut-point selection.
postconditions: Every visible entry influences pressure and boundary selection.
atomic_candidates.alignment: direct_pi; Aider has a related message-tokenizer but not the same session-entry projection

atomic_candidates.problem_mechanism: A summarizer can use a budget inconsistent with the main model or caller-selected limit, causing under-fitting or unnecessary history loss.
atomic_candidates.operator: Derive a bounded history budget from input capacity, allow an explicit caller budget, and pass that value into prefix selection.
postconditions: Selected history prefix fits the input budget.
atomic_candidates.alignment: direct_within_aider; adjacent to Pi policy propagation

atomic_candidates.problem_mechanism: A failed summary can otherwise replace usable history with missing or partial context.
atomic_candidates.operator: Catch the handled summarizer failure, retain original messages, and emit a visible warning; if configured, try a fallback summarizer model.
postconditions: Original context remains available after failure.
atomic_candidates.alignment: direct_within_aider; partial cross-repository alignment with Pi overflow/cancellation recovery

cross_repository_evidence_matrix.aider: summarize_real selects a fitting older prefix and retains a tail; smaller-result oracle

rejected_alignments.claim: Aider proves Pi's residual output reservation or provider shared-capacity arithmetic
rejected_alignments.reason: No reviewed Aider code charges downstream output reservation against the same provider context window.

rejected_alignments.claim: Pi's reserveTokens is identical to Aider's max_chat_history_tokens
rejected_alignments.reason: They are different settings with different callers and different test oracles.

rejected_alignments.claim: All compaction/context commits are one workflow because their subjects contain context or budget
rejected_alignments.reason: The DAG is split at distinct causal seams: policy resolution, request gating, safe boundary repair, history fitting, and failure recovery.

promotion_decision.reason: Real provenance, implementation/call-point reading, and checked-in oracles support candidate Atomics and two repository-local workflow DAGs. There is no held-out transfer evaluation in this run, and cross-repository alignment is partial rather than proof of one shared pattern.
